results.title: South African gold miner expands global footprint with $4.3bn acquisition bid in Australia - Business Insider Africa
results.content: South African gold miner Pan African Resources has launched a R80 billion (about $4.3 billion) acquisition bid in Australia, marking a major step in its strategy to expand its global mining footprint and consolidate control over key gold assets in the region. * Pan African Resources has launched an R80 billion ($4.3 billion) bid to acquire Australian mining company Emmerson Resources. * Emmerson shareholders will receive 0.1493 Pan African shares for each share they hold, and Pan African will list on the Australian Securities Exchange. * markets  Africa's richest man, Dangote, proposes $17B refinery in Kenya despite Ruto's hopes for a regional joint project. For over five years, Pan African Resources, a South African gold mining company, has partnered with the Australian firm Emmerson Resources. The deal is valued at approximately R80 billion and aims to strengthen Pan African Resources’ control over mineral assets in the Tennant Creek mineral fields of Northern Australia.

results.title: Here are the 2 big things we're watching in the stock market in the week ahead - CNBC
results.content: # Here are the 2 big things we're watching in the stock market in the week ahead. First-quarter earnings season is winding down, but one Club name is set to report this week and several pieces of important economic data are on deck. 1. Earnings: Qnity Electronics is our only stock on the earnings calendar, with results due out before the open Tuesday morning. Given all we've heard this earnings season about the demand for AI computing power, we feel good about the numbers Qnity is set to report. The one area where we're prepared to see some weakness is in consumer electronics, where demand could take a hit due to the rapid rise in memory prices. That was on display Friday, when the University of Michigan's consumer sentiment report fell to a record low in May. The morning after the CPI report, the April producer price index (PPI) is due out.

results.content: # AngloGold Ashanti (NYSE:AU) Valuation Check As Record Q1 Cash Flow And US$2b Buyback Grab Attention. AngloGold Ashanti (AU) is back in focus after Q1 2026 results combined strong free cash flow, higher headline earnings and steady production with a record interim dividend and a proposed US$2.0b share repurchase program. See our latest analysis for AngloGold Ashanti. The Q1 2026 update and proposed US$2.0b buyback follow a strong run, with a 25.04% year to date share price return and a very large 5 year total shareholder return of 378.34%. With record free cash flow, headline earnings well ahead of last year and a proposed US$2.0b buyback on the table, is AngloGold Ashanti still trading at an attractive discount, or is the stock already pricing in future growth? At a last close of $107.03 versus a narrative fair value of $121.86, the AngloGold Ashanti story centers on stronger earnings power supported by long term project growth.
